# descope_smtp_connector (Resource)

Manages a SMTP connector and its configuration in a Descope project. A general purpose SMTP connector for sending emails through your own mail server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to authenticate with the SMTP server.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `sender_email` (String) The email address that emails are sent from. Make sure it is properly registered with your server.
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) The authentication method to use when connecting to the SMTP server.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `port` (Number) The port the SMTP server listens on.
- `sender_name` (String) The name shown as the sender of the emails.
- `use_static_ips` (Boolean) Whether the connector should send all requests from specific static IPs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
